core_meaning.primary_meaning: Cumhur is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The public, multitude”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Cumhur corresponds to the Arabic form جُمْهُور (Arabic root ج م ه ر (j-m-h-r); جُمْهُور (Jumhūr)). Its core sense is cumhur; the public, multitude (turkish form). Cumhur is the Turkish form of Arabic جُمْهُور (Jumhūr), meaning 'the public, multitude'.

persian.name: جمهور

arabic.name: جُمْهُور
